<layout:root>
  <layout:column>
    <textCard>
      <text_title>The Domain</text_title>
      <text_subtitle>Think of it as the "Guest List" for your function. If you're not on the list, you can't get in.</text_subtitle>
    </textCard>
    <layout:row>
      <textCard>
        <text_title>CORE DEFINITION</text_title>
        <text_text>The complete set of all possible **input values** (usually \(x\)) for which the function is defined.</text_text>
        <text_subtitle>⏱ Also known as the "Independent Variables".</text_subtitle>
      </textCard>
      <summaryCard>
        <title>Visualizing Domain: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\)</title>
        <preview src="file:///sdcard/Pictures/Camera/camera_1786008139046.jpg"></preview>
        <text>Allowed Inputs (Domain): \([0, \infty)\)</text>
      </summaryCard>
      <summaryCard>
        <title>The Input-Output Rule</title>
        <text>Every function has boundaries. The Domain ensures the math stays "real" and avoids errors like dividing by zero.</text>
        <preview src="file:///sdcard/Pictures/Camera/camera_1786008203681.jpg"></preview>
        <commitWide href="https://example.com/learn/domain/self-test">Knowledge Self-Test</commitWide>
      </summaryCard>
    </layout:row>
    <heroCard>
      <cta_secondary href="https://example.com/learn/domain/mastered">Mastered</cta_secondary>
      <cta_primary href="https://example.com/learn/domain/self-test">Knowledge Self-Test</cta_primary>
    </heroCard>
  </layout:column>
</layout:root>
